note: Product shapes that recur across top-chart Roblox games (factory docs/research/monetization-ads-store-2026-10.md). tools/monetize.py picks from these per genre (genre_sets.json) and writes catalog/1, offers/1, boosts/1, perks/1 and shop/1 files plus a plan with suggested prices. Prices here are suggestions for the owner's Creator Hub entry only: they never go into catalog or UI data (Roblox reads prices at runtime; regional pricing and price optimization change them). {currency} is the game's soft currency label, {Currency} its display name. pvp: safe (cosmetic or convenience), caution (helps progress, not fights), avoid (sells power over other players: off by default in PvP genres). random: true sells a random outcome (paid_random_item tag: odds disclosure, PolicyService gate, release check A05).

archetypes.name: VIP
archetypes.description: VIP tag, VIP-only area and +25% {Currency} forever.
archetypes.icon: crown or gold star badge on the game's mascot, gold rim
archetypes.why: Status plus a modest boost; the most common pass in top games and an easy first purchase.

archetypes.name: 2x {Currency}
archetypes.description: Earn double {Currency} from everything, forever.
archetypes.icon: big '2x' over a pile of the game's currency
archetypes.why: The single best-selling pass shape in simulators, tycoons and idle games; value is obvious.

archetypes.name: 2x XP
archetypes.description: Level up twice as fast, forever.
archetypes.icon: '2x' with an XP star or level-up arrow
archetypes.why: Pairs with level-based progression (RPG, shooter ranks, battlegrounds) without selling raw power.

archetypes.name: +Storage
archetypes.description: More inventory slots for items, pets or units.
archetypes.icon: open backpack or chest overflowing
archetypes.why: Convenience that grows with play time; collectors hit the cap and buy.

archetypes.name: +Equip Slots
archetypes.description: Equip more pets, units or tools at once.
archetypes.icon: extra slots lighting up beside the character
archetypes.why: Pet and unit games sell equip slots as a top pass; it multiplies every other upgrade.

archetypes.name: Auto Collect
archetypes.description: Automatically collect {Currency} and drops near you.
archetypes.icon: magnet pulling coins
archetypes.why: Removes the most repetitive action in tycoons and simulators; strong conversion.

archetypes.name: Sell Anywhere
archetypes.description: Sell your haul from anywhere, no trip back to the shop.
archetypes.icon: portable cash register or bag with a lightning bolt
archetypes.why: Classic simulator convenience pass; saves walking time every loop.

archetypes.name: Speed Boost
archetypes.description: Move 30% faster everywhere.
archetypes.icon: running shoe with motion lines
archetypes.why: Cheap entry pass for obbies and big maps; in PvP it is a fight advantage, so it is off there.

archetypes.name: 2x Luck
archetypes.description: Double your luck on every roll, egg or drop.
archetypes.icon: four-leaf clover with '2x' and sparkles
archetypes.why: The headline pass of RNG and pet games; luck stacks with boosts and server luck.

archetypes.name: Fast Open
archetypes.description: Open eggs, crates or rolls 3x faster, and open 3 at once.
archetypes.icon: three eggs or crates bursting open together
archetypes.why: Pet and RNG games sell open speed and multi-open as top passes; it speeds the core reward loop.

archetypes.name: Premium Plot
archetypes.description: A bigger plot or house with extra build space.
archetypes.icon: a bigger glowing house or plot outline
archetypes.why: Tycoons and life sims sell space and status; visible to other players, so it advertises itself.

archetypes.name: Emote Pack
archetypes.description: A set of exclusive emotes and animations.
archetypes.icon: character mid-dance with music notes
archetypes.why: Social and roleplay players buy self-expression; zero balance risk in any genre.

archetypes.name: Rainbow Trail
archetypes.description: A glowing trail and name colour that everyone sees.
archetypes.icon: rainbow streak behind a running avatar
archetypes.why: Low-price, visible, fair in PvP; the safest first pass for competitive genres.

archetypes.name: Radio
archetypes.description: Play music from the game's licensed library for players near you.
archetypes.icon: boombox with music notes
archetypes.why: Hangout and roleplay staple. Use catalogue or owned audio only; players' own audio ids need moderation and privacy checks.

archetypes.name: Season Pass
archetypes.description: Unlock the premium reward track for this season.
archetypes.icon: ribbon banner with the season's emblem
archetypes.why: Battle-pass style tracks (GameKit/SeasonTrack) monetize retention; resell each season as a new pass.

archetypes.name: Handful of {Currency}
archetypes.description: A small {Currency} top-up.
archetypes.icon: a few coins
archetypes.why: Ladder entry point; makes the bigger packs look like better value.

archetypes.name: Pouch of {Currency}
archetypes.description: {Currency} to spend on upgrades.
archetypes.icon: a pouch of coins
archetypes.why: Ladder step 2; bonus grows with each step (amount_base already includes it).

archetypes.name: Chest of {Currency}
archetypes.description: A big chest of {Currency}.
archetypes.icon: an open chest of coins
archetypes.why: The middle pack is the most bought when it carries the 'most popular' ribbon (decoy against the extremes).

archetypes.name: Vault of {Currency}
archetypes.description: A vault of {Currency}: the best value.
archetypes.icon: a vault door bursting with coins
archetypes.why: Best value per Robux; where most currency revenue comes from in top games (whales).

archetypes.name: Mountain of {Currency}
archetypes.description: The biggest {Currency} pack.
archetypes.icon: a mountain of coins with a crown
archetypes.why: Price anchor at the top of the ladder (top games list a 1,999-7,999 'whale anchor'); a few players buy it and it makes the rest look cheap.

archetypes.name: Starter Pack
archetypes.description: A one-time bundle for new players: {Currency}, a boost and an exclusive item.
archetypes.icon: gift box with the exclusive item peeking out, 'STARTER' banner
archetypes.why: First purchase converts non-payers; once a player pays once they pay again. Show early, once a session, with a personal 24 h timer.

archetypes.name: 2x {Currency} (30 min)
archetypes.description: Double {Currency} for 30 minutes of play.
archetypes.icon: '2x' coin with a stopwatch
archetypes.why: Repeatable timed boosts are the main repeat-purchase product of simulators; stack with the pass.

archetypes.name: Luck Potion (15 min)
archetypes.description: Double luck for 15 minutes.
archetypes.icon: green potion bottle with a clover
archetypes.why: RNG and pet games sell luck potions as the top repeat product.

archetypes.name: Server Luck (10 min)
archetypes.description: Triple luck for everyone in this server, with your name announced.
archetypes.icon: golden clover over a crowd, '3x SERVER'
archetypes.why: Social purchase: the buyer is thanked server-wide and everyone benefits, so it drives co-play and repeat buys.

archetypes.name: Skip Stage
archetypes.description: Skip the stage you are stuck on.
archetypes.icon: fast-forward arrow over a stage marker
archetypes.why: Obby staple: offered at the moment of frustration (several fails on one stage), never as a popup on join.

archetypes.name: Revive
archetypes.description: Come back where you fell, with full health.
archetypes.icon: glowing heart with a plus
archetypes.why: Survival, horror and PvE wave games sell revives at the death screen; in PvP it buys a fight, so it is off there.

archetypes.name: Time Skip (1 h)
archetypes.description: Instantly get one hour of idle earnings.
archetypes.icon: hourglass spinning with coins
archetypes.why: Idle and tycoon games sell time; value scales with progress, so late players keep buying.

archetypes.name: Lucky Crate
archetypes.description: Open a crate with a chance at rare items. Odds shown before you buy.
archetypes.icon: glowing crate with a question mark
archetypes.why: Paid random items earn well in collection games but need odds shown before purchase and a PolicyService gate (players in some countries cannot buy them). Off unless the game owner opts in.

archetypes.name: Gift VIP
archetypes.description: Buy VIP for a friend in this server.
archetypes.icon: VIP crown in a gift box
archetypes.why: Passes cannot be bought for others, so top games sell a developer product that grants the same entitlement to a chosen player.

archetypes.name: Support the Developers
archetypes.description: A thank-you tip. You get a supporter badge on the donation board.
archetypes.icon: heart in a jar
archetypes.why: Hangouts and showcases with little to sell use a donation board leaderboard (GameKit/Leaderboard) for status.

archetypes.name: VIP Club
archetypes.description: Monthly: daily {Currency}, VIP tag and a monthly exclusive item.
archetypes.icon: membership card with the game's logo
archetypes.why: Experience subscriptions (local-currency tiers) add recurring revenue for games with daily play; benefits must be honoured on every platform. Not available in 12 countries.
